card.text: Explore Liberatrix in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 157 shape model
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with a thermophysical volume scale of 51.1 ± 2.1 km (reported model-ensemble range). An alternative pole remains possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 157 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 25.55 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
